summary_md: **Praex ([@Praexai](https://x.com/Praexai/status/2115858395106533409))** releases open-weight **Lucia III**, an agent model post-trained from GLM-5.3 on 1,195 passing runs out of 2,000 NVIDIA Nemotron terminal tasks on one 8×B200 node; self-run Terminal-Bench 2.1 is 68.8% and TB 2.0 68.9% vs. 58.1% for GLM-5.3, with all trials public on Harbor Hub ([weights](https://huggingface.co/praex/Lucia-III), [TB 2.1 runs](https://hub.harborframework.com/jobs/30cac5da-1bb0-4750-8625-f28653ed44d2), [TB 2.0 runs](https://hub.harborframework.com/jobs/bef60fa2-3ac4-4db3-85bd-6fbdadcf5b5f)).
relevance: Transparent rejection-sampling recipe for agentic models.
